policy: Explicit editorial decisions override automated triage state. Publication authorization is valid only when the referenced canonical GlassesResearch publication already exists or is created in the same reviewed change.

decisions.editorial_notes: Already verified and incorporated on 2026-08-13; the collector resurfaced an existing published source rather than a new editorial event.

The collector lead was independently verified against MemoMind and XGIMI primary product/brand material. The verified $399 Kickstarter acquisition route crosses the existing canonical admission threshold, so MemoMind One is published as GLS-0160 with state preorder/crowdfunding; broad fulfillment and owner-control questions remain unknown.
A primary manufacturer source for the reported Leopard Bird iO Series launch could not be reproduced during verification. Retain the lead without publishing the claim.

The high-priority collector lead was independently verified against RayNeo-provided August 21 launch material and current first-party iO and GT product/support pages. The announcement is publishable as a verified availability change. No new GLS IDs are assigned because the checked pages state a September 4 launch/availability milestone but do not yet establish a paid preorder or ordinary purchase path.
